title: Quantum Optical Neuron for Image Classification via Multiphoton Interference
summary: The rapid growth of machine learning is increasingly constrained by the energy and bandwidth limits of classical hardware. Optical and quantum technologies offer an alternative route, enabling high-dimensional, parallel information processing directly in the physical layer, particularly suited for imaging tasks. In this context, quantum photonic platforms provide both a natural mechanism for computing inner products and a promising path to energy-efficient inference in photon-limited regimes.
